rawContent: A jail sentence of 19-24 years doesn't bring #WalterScott back to life. Putting one police officer behind bars doesn't change the system. We need to keep demanding #justice and #policereform to end #policebrutality forever. #BlackLivesMatter  https://t.co/IeXmgIXqc3

Justice remains incomplete until #policebrutality is stopped forever. Until that is achieved we cannot rest, not even in these rare moments when it appears that #justice is on our side. #BlackLivesMatter #WalterScott https://t.co/jKT9Ofyn0e

Dying from racialized trauma and a broken heart is a real danger facing Black women. Rest in power, Erica Garner. Thank you for your goodness, your leadership and your perseverance toward justice. #blacklivesmatter
#GoldenGlobes are worth watching this year! #MeToo #TaranaBurke is the leader of this movement & I am thrilled to see her commitment to women and women of color being honored.
Taking note of the men who are wearing #TimesUp pins or being verbal about supporting the #MeToo movement and those who aren't. #GoldenGlobes
Love that @alisonbrie is talking about getting strong by lifting weights so she can lift up her fellow women- literally and figuratively! #MeToo #Feminism

Good lesson on how to show up to support a movement when you have power and privilege (even while knowing that power and privilege do not protect women from sexism and rape culture). #GoldenGlobes #MeToo https://t.co/eXPsnODE9n
